trigger_condition.memory_trigger: selected row flattened memory offset exceeds INT32_MAX
trigger_condition.value_trigger: valid indices whose flattened offset exceeds INT32_MAX

concrete_constraints.index_values: valid indices targeting rows around ceil(2^31 / row_size)-1 and ceil(2^31 / row_size)

root_cause.kernel_layer: MPS backend kernel uses 32-bit offset calculation for large tensors; index * stride overflows INT32_MAX.
root_cause.backend_layer: Backend address calculation overflow silently produces zero rows instead of raising an error.
root_cause.numerical_layer: INT32_MAX overflow in flattened memory offset calculation.

bug_oracle.description: MPS index_select/embedding silently returns all-zero rows for valid indices when selected row offset exceeds INT32_MAX.
bug_oracle.signal: Silent mismatch between MPS output and CPU/reference output; all-zero rows for valid indices indicate a bug.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Vary index values around boundary indices such as ceil(2^31 / row_size)-1 and ceil(2^31 / row_size).
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Create large source tensors or embedding tables with numel near or above 2^31 and row_size that makes the boundary reachable.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Force MPS backend; ensure source tensor numel > 2^31 and selected index multiplied by row_size exceeds INT32_MAX.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Create large source tensor -> move to MPS -> run torch.index_select or embedding -> compare output with CPU reference.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Compare MPS output against CPU reference; flag all-zero rows for nonzero expected rows as incorrect output.
